title: Cinematic 3D world with a title
summary: A generative 3D world under a slow camera that ends on a film-style title: a low flight along a river through a mountain valley that climbs over a ridge to reveal the low sun, or an orbital sunrise breaking over a planet's limb.
techniques: baked heightfield sun shadows and ambient occlusion
analytic sky shared by sky, fog and water
gallery_share: Generated landscape flyovers and space openers with a title are a staple of model-made video galleries.
limits: Stylised, painterly worlds: no trees, buildings, volumetric clouds or water reflections of the land
Two worlds (terrain, planet) and a fixed camera grammar per world
The sun reveal time depends a little on the seeded terrain (about 0.42-0.5 of the duration)
Software WebGL: about 6.6 s (terrain) and 3.9 s (planet) of render per output second at 1080x1920
